description:
Cast Wingrattle Scarecrow by paying {3}.
Wingrattle Scarecrow enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Reaper King triggers, destroying Wingrattle Scarecrow.
Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat from step 3.
